title: v0ltzsiREFINED
description: The Official V0LTZSI Modpack which includes all of the Mods that V0ltzsi uses in his Hardcore Minecraft Series!
body:
A REVAMPED VANILLA MINECRAFT EXPERIENCE Every single mod and resource pack in this mod pack is aimed to polish the Minecraft experience, enhancing everything from the UI, QOL, sounds, building, structures, and plenty more.

PERFORMANCE Countless mods improve performance in almost every way possible from world generation and entity culling to memory usage and even the rendering of text in game.

POLISHED UI Plenty of mods enhance the UI, adding animations to opening and closing the inventory, moving items, smoothly scrolling inventories and plenty more.

DETAILS 3D crops, ladders, doors, vines, glow lichen, rails, lanterns and chains all for some added depth. Spring Flowers & More Grass Heights add several variations to each flower and height variation to tall and short grass.
